label: Dark drawer teaspoon
test_scope: Offline synthetic tests. Forces and mass are engineering assumptions, not hardware measurements.
physics_source: Generated from model.json and convex collision pieces
physics_notes:
# dark_drawer_teaspoon

Round 2 size variant split from the wrongly reused large-spoon mesh. Two observed layers in the narrow right channel; hidden count and layer identity are uncertain. Bowl/head geometry follows its separate three-frame source mask.

Canonical mesh envelope: [0.047642, 0.194123, 0.016605] m (X,Y,Z). Mass 0.04339 kg and friction 0.45 are guesses. All contents are independent rigid bodies. No observed articulation belongs to this rigid design.

Contact model: 74 convex pieces. Thin walls, rounded visual edges and contact margins are simplified. Spoons use eight hull sectors preserving the bowl depression; narrow tine channels use separate hulls. Pitcher handle uses two coarse hulls and six wall sectors; full finger clearance and internal fit are approximate. Blender compound collisions are supplied; motor control, fluid, deformation, wear, cutting and breakage are outside this model.

Texture is a source photo crop blended at 32% with an inferred base colour. Illumination/reflections remain baked in; roughness and metallic are assumed, not recovered PBR measurements. No logos invented.

Review contains native source crops and three studio views. Studio cameras approximate readable viewpoints; they are not calibrated silhouette validation. Counter poses have multi-view endpoint checks where available. Drawer and pitcher contents have larger occlusion uncertainty. No accuracy threshold or manipulation success is claimed.

Rebuild with Blender 4.2: `blender -b -P build.py`; shared generator is `../build_common.py`, settings `../assets.json`. Timing in model.json measures this offline geometry/export/render run only.

physics_properties.mass_source: Sum of signed visual solid volumes after welding GLB UV/normal seams, multiplied by material density. Manufacturing submesh overlaps are not boolean-unioned; estimate is not a weighed product. Collision shell chord volumes are not used as material mass.
physics_properties.centre_of_mass_method: Density-weighted convex compound approximation, with separate polymer/steel or bamboo/silicone components; patch overlap remains approximate.
physics_properties.articulation: No rigid joint observed; utensils are independently removable. Parent references are containment, except the organizer drawer transform.
physics_properties.mass_justification: 0.04339 kg = sum of visual material solid volumes x nominal material densities; see density_mass_estimate. Product identity and scale weights were not measured.

density_mass_estimate.method: Sum of signed visual solid volumes after welding GLB UV/normal seams, multiplied by material density. Manufacturing submesh overlaps are not boolean-unioned; estimate is not a weighed product. Collision shell chord volumes are not used as material mass.

physics_properties.density_volume_caveat: Sum includes overlapping convex patches; cavity geometry does not fill the bounding box. Composite materials and coating thickness are approximate.
physics_properties.blender_dynamic_origin: COM; custom property canonical_com_offset maps back to canonical OBJ/GLB frame. World-space geometry stays unchanged.

provenance.geometry: Reconstructed from kitchen video; hidden surfaces are completed. Scale and material appearance remain approximate.
provenance.motion: Observed trajectories where documented; unobserved axes and endpoints are assumptions.
provenance.forces: Simulation measurements of assumed parameters; not force measurements from video.

visual_bindings_note: Visuals use the latest asset revision; mechanism geometry may predate it. Body rest offsets preserve the visual placement.
